snippet.title: ALATURKA — Official Trailer | 1970s Open World Istanbul
snippet.description:
Wishlist ALATURKA on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4226560?utm_source=bufuakgames&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=wishlistrailer

A low-poly open-world action game set in 1970s Bosforus.
Slice döner, drive cars that actually weigh something, and try not to die broke.

Built live on stream by a solo developer. No publisher.
